title: ADOPT the Metro Toll Credit/Transportation Development Credit Program Guidelines for eligible Los Angeles County local highway and transit projects that are…
text:
[Metro Board file 2026-0524, Policy]
ADOPT the Metro Toll Credit/Transportation Development Credit Program Guidelines for eligible Los Angeles County local highway and transit projects that are programmed in the Federal Transportation Improvement Program (Attachment A).
summary: Metro would adopt guidelines for using toll credits, a federal funding match, on eligible Los Angeles County local highway and transit projects programmed in the federal transportation improvement program.
